SELECT q.id, q.user_id as userId, q.continuous_days as day, q.reward_amount as amount, q.reward_type as qdtype, DATE_FORMAT(q.sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createDate, q.user_id as creator, u.mobile, u.agent as agent, agent_user.username as agentName, u.salesmanid as salesmanid, salesman_user.username as salesmanName, CASE WHEN q.continuous_days = 1 THEN 1 WHEN q.continuous_days = 2 THEN 2 WHEN q.continuous_days = 3 THEN 3 WHEN q.continuous_days = 4 THEN 4 WHEN q.continuous_days = 5 THEN 5 WHEN q.continuous_days = 6 THEN 6 WHEN q.continuous_days = 7 THEN 7 ELSE 0 END as partDay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_sign_in WHERE user_id = q.user_id AND status = 1) as sumday, 0 as couponid, '' as couponName, 0 as privilegeid, '' as privilegeName, u.biaoqian, CASE WHEN u.invite_code IS NOT NULL AND u.invite_code != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as inviteCodeStatus FROM tb_user_sign_in q LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON q.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user agent_user ON u.agent = agent_user.id LEFT JOIN sys_user salesman_user ON u.salesmanid = salesman_user.id WHERE q.status = 1
AND u.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.mobile}, '%')
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.username}, '%')
AND u.agent = #{params.agent}
AND u.salesmanid = #{params.salesmanid}
AND u.biaoqian LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.biaoqian}, '%')
AND u.biaoqian IS NOT NULL AND u.biaoqian != ''
AND (u.biaoqian IS NULL OR u.biaoqian = '')
AND u.superior_name IS NOT NULL AND u.superior_name != ''
AND (u.superior_name IS NULL OR u.superior_name = '')
AND q.sign_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND q.sign_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
AND u.agent = #{params.currentUserId}
AND u.salesmanid = #{params.currentUserId}
ORDER BY ${params.orderField}
ASC DESC DESC
ORDER BY q.sign_time DESC
